positive.prompt: Deslop this pull request description and remove all AI buzzwords and chatbot tells
Edit this technical architecture documentation to remove fluffy metaphors and passive voice
Clean up these verbose AI-generated code comments so they only state concrete invariants
Remove sycophantic chatbot phrases and filler from our ADR draft

negative.prompt: Find the root cause of this null pointer exception in the build logs
Decompile this ELF binary and explain its assembly instructions

evals.prompt: Edit an AI-written pull request description full of terms like 'crucial', 'delve', 'testament to', and sycophantic greetings.
evals.expected_output: A deslopped, active-voice technical summary stating concrete changes, measurements, and verification proof.
expectations: Eliminates AI vocabulary tells such as delve, crucial, testament, or tapestry
Removes chatbot conversational greetings and filler pleasantries
Replaces emotional or vague qualifiers with concrete technical mechanisms
